methods.what: Displacement field of an elastic medium expressed via integrals of derivatives of 1/ϱ (Lamé constants λ, μ)
Dilatation θ computed from the displacement field
Normal and shear stresses from the displacements
Correction term built from integrating Δ²N to cancel boundary stresses
Method of images: sequence of mirrored source positions for a plate between x=±a/2
Image-series terms added to stresses and displacements
